content.value: Consider a stack which starts at location 5000H and has a size of 80 bytes. Now draw the stack (12) by showing SP register for each of the following consecutive operations: (i) push 6, (ii) push 17, (iii) pop, (iv) push 5483, (v) push 456, and (vi) pop.
